component.name: LeafBook
component.summary: Local-first Markdown book reader and editor

description.p: LeafBook turns local Markdown collections into books that can be read and edited. It is an independent derivative of the open-source MarkText editor.

ul.li: Realtime preview and a distraction-free writing experience
GitHub Flavored Markdown, math expressions, diagrams, and front matter
Local files remain the source of truth
